title: Report agent spawn admission truth
description:
Objective: consume the start-admission contract from task-d4329e8d020f40308209397079c5004d so the orchestrator never reports SPAWNED when startup was refused and no child exists.

Deliverable: agent-wrapper awaits only startup admission (never child exit), returns a report with a distinguishable refusal outcome plus exact code/layer, records active work only for admitted children, and the wrapper main awaits that report before printing it. This replaces blocked task-58fd2c3781254d839ee27867f8f9f4e6, whose synchronous/no-contract-change rails were impossible against an exit-lifetime Promise.

NOT in scope: changing spawn validation/quoting or credential-write order, reimplementing agentSpawnInvocation, inventing codes for unknown exceptions, changing the wrapper verifier/poll interval, or waiting for an agent to exit before returning the staffing report.

Verification: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`; both legs are read separately and the daemon test output must show a nonzero executed count.
definitionOfDone: A real spawner preflight refusal driven through the wrapper returns a non-SPAWNED report that asserts `SPAWN_ARGUMENT_UNQUOTABLE` and `agent-spawn-invocation` literally; the test also proves the refusal came from the spawner layer, not an earlier wrapper guard.
An admitted start still reports the existing SPAWNED shape before its held-open exit promise settles, and existing success assertions remain intact after only the required async caller adaptation.
The wrapper/main wait only for startup admission and never for child exit; a held-open child test proves runOnce/reporting completes while the child remains active.
A refused start is never inserted into the active map and leaves activeCount at its exact prior value; an admitted start is inserted once and deleted in a finally path when its exit settles.
No rejection is blanket-swallowed: the typed refusal becomes a coded report, while any unclassified start failure rejects/fails closed rather than being logged or reported as SPAWNED.
Restoring the unconditional SPAWNED branch turns the named refusal code/layer test red; restore is byte-exact by SHA-256.
Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` passes under path-attributed baseline rules, and daemon Vitest output proves nonzero execution.
taskRails: Depends on task-d4329e8d020f40308209397079c5004d; do not mock or locally reimplement its start-admission contract if it is absent on disk.
The wrapper report must name both the stable code and refusing layer. `outcome !== SPAWNED` alone is not acceptance evidence.
Make runOnce/callers asynchronous only to await startup admission. Awaiting the child-exit promise would serialize the wrapper and is forbidden.
Do not touch agent-spawner production or tests in this consumer task; producer and consumer must remain independently reviewable.
Preserve the verifier and polling loop except for awaiting the truthful runOnce result, and commit only explicit owned paths.
blockedReason: Required producer surface is absent on current disk, so the task rail forbids a consumer plan. Fresh measurement at HEAD 2e34a5f: `rg -n "Spawn(Start|Admission)|startAgent|exitPromise|admission" apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-spawner.ts apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-spawner.test.ts` returns zero matches. `claudeSpawner` is still the sole public start surface and returns `(SpawnRequest) => Promise<void>`; that Promise is constructed around the child and resolves only in finish() on exit/error/timeout. The wrapper still types spawnAgent as `(request) => Promise<void>`, calls it without awaiting startup, immediately records active, and returns SPAWNED. Producer task-d4329e8d020f40308209397079c5004d is PLANNING and assigned to architect-09b5f32a. Consumer rails explicitly forbid mocking/reimplementing that contract or editing producer files, so no production-ready plan can name the result shape until it lands. A second transient collision also exists: agent-wrapper.ts and agent-wrapper.test.ts have unstaged foreign HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS edits; they must be committed/cleared by their owner before this consumer touches those paths. Unblock after the producer is DONE on disk and the wrapper paths are clean; then remeasure exact exported symbol/type and plan the async startup-only consumer.
